description: Generate coupon/payment accrual periods between an effective and a termination date: monthly to annual frequency, backward or forward roll, short or long stub, optional end-of-month rule, business-day adjustment per calendar. Returns each period's unadjusted and adjusted start and end. This is where hand-rolled date code goes wrong; do not approximate it.

calendar.description: Holiday calendar: us-federal (US federal holidays), nyse (NYSE trading days), sifma-us (US bond market), target (euro settlement), uk (England and Wales bank holidays).

convention.description: Adjustment for every date except termination. Default modified-following.

effective.description: ISO calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-03-15). Zero-padded, no time or timezone.

endOfMonth.description: When true and the anchor is a month-end, every roll date is a month-end.

frequency.description: Coupon frequency: annual, semiannual, quarterly, or monthly.

generation.description: Roll direction; backward (default) puts any stub in front.

stub.description: Keep the short stub (default) or merge it into its neighbor.

terminationConvention.description: Adjustment for the termination date. Default: same as convention.

name: generate_schedule

periods.description: The accrual periods in date order.

title: Generate a payment schedule
